After that, get the current time in Asia/Tokyo, fetch any Tokyo weather alert, and send that alert by email to alice@company.com. Finally, look up Alice’s contact info using contact name alice and user ID user_01, and email me a trip planning summary covering all of this for Hilton Tokyo, Tokyo, 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-13, flight AA100, and Alice Johnson.
